brand.headline: Operational control for e-commerce logistics
brand.description: Manage the plan catalog, registered companies, their subscriptions, and user oversight — from one secure hub for Rawafid staff.

home.metaDescription: Rawafid platform admin hub — plans, companies, and users.
home.title: Welcome, {{name}}
home.subtitle: You're in the platform admin console. The modules below will go live as each screen ships.
home.modulesSubtitle: Browse and manage platform resources from each module.

modules.readOnlyHint: Your role is view-only until these pages ship.
modules.manageHint: Full management will be available when this module launches.
modules.openHint: Browse registered merchants and their subscription context.

carriers.title: Shipping partners
carriers.description: Turn carrier adapters on or off for merchant connections.

carriers.metaDescription: Enable or disable carrier adapters that merchants can connect.

hero.title: Shipping partners
hero.subtitle: Merchants only see carriers that are enabled and running in this deployment.

carriers.notRunningHint: This deployment has no adapter, so merchants cannot see it.
carriers.manageHint: Enabled carriers appear on the merchant connections screen.
carriers.readOnlyHint: Support can view carriers. Only a super admin can change them.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

form.createDescription: Register a carrier on a shared platform. Delivery areas download right after it is created.
form.editDescription: Names, sort order, and platform settings. Changing settings re-downloads delivery areas.
form.savingAreas: Downloading this partner's delivery areas can take a minute. You can close this window; a message will tell you when it is saved.

fields.baseUrlHint: Must start with https:// and end with /graphql
fields.returnsHint: Merchants can book returns through this partner only while this is on.
fields.baseUrlHintMega: Must be https://…/api/shipment.php exactly, with no trailing slash and no query.
fields.baseUrlInvalidMega: Enter the full address ending in /api/shipment.php, with no trailing slash or query.
fields.syncAccountHint: An API user of this carrier, not a dashboard login. It is used to download delivery areas.
fields.syncAccountHintWingezz: A Wingezz account login. Wingezz needs it even to list its delivery areas.

toast.deleteFailed: Could not remove the shipping partner

delete.title: Remove shipping partner?
delete.description: Remove {{name}} from the catalog. This is only allowed while no merchant has connected it.

form.advancedHint: Support settings. Most carriers keep the defaults.

regions.metaDescription: Review {{name}} cities, zones, and districts, and check where an address would be booked.

hero.title: {{name}} coverage
hero.subtitle: The carrier's own cities, zones, and districts. A weekly sync keeps them current.

sync.hint: Downloads this carrier's geography. Bosta can take a few seconds. A failed sync changes nothing.
sync.readOnly: Support can view coverage. Only a super admin can sync.
sync.notResponding: The shipping partner is not responding. Nothing was changed.
sync.summary: Added {{added}}, updated {{updated}}, retired {{retired}}. {{total}} districts on file.
sync.unmappedTitle: Some cities could not be placed
sync.unmappedHint: {{count}} carrier cities are not inside one of our governorates, so their districts never match an address.
sync.unmappedHintAccurate: {{count}} lines from the carrier were not placed in a governorate. On Accurate partners, billing zones (for example return invoices) are expected here and are safe to ignore.
sync.accountRejected: The carrier refused the sync account. Check the carrier settings — retrying will not help.

toolbar.title: Filter districts
toolbar.searchPlaceholder: City, zone, or district in Arabic or English…

empty.title: No districts yet
empty.description: Sync this carrier to download its geography. Retired districts stay listed and are never deleted.
empty.filteredDescription: Try another governorate or spelling. Search tolerates small differences, including Arabic spelling.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
errors.governorates: Could not load governorates. Search still works.

resolve.title: Where would this address go?
resolve.description: Pick a governorate and type a district the way a booking would. This does not create a shipment.
resolve.districtRequired: Type a district or area name.
resolve.fallback: No confident district. Booking sends this primary city plus the typed name, and the carrier resolves it:
resolve.noCity: This carrier has no city in that governorate, so the address cannot be placed.

methodHelp.DISTRICT: The text is a district's own name.
methodHelp.ZONE: The text is a zone name. A district in that zone stands in for it.
methodHelp.HEAD: The text starts district names that all sit in one zone.
methodHelp.NONE: Candidates were not confident enough to pick one hub. We never guess between two zones.

companies.metaDescription: Browse registered merchant companies, their plans, teams, and subscription history on the Rawafid platform.

hero.title: Companies directory
hero.subtitle: Every storefront on Rawafid lives here — search by store name or account number, inspect plans, and review subscription history.

toolbar.title: Search and sort companies
toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by company name or account number…
toolbar.searchHint: Matches store name anywhere, or account number from the start.

empty.title: No companies yet
empty.description: When merchants register on Rawafid, their companies will appear here for platform oversight.
empty.searchDescription: Try a different store name or account number prefix.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

detail.metaDescription: Operational profile, team, and subscription history for {{name}} on Rawafid.

billing.title: Billing & wallet
billing.subtitle: Prepaid balance, plan assignment, and subscription history for this merchant.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.subtitle: Registration facts and logistics footprint for this merchant tenant.
profile.logisticsDescription: Ship-from country and declared volume help the platform understand routing and capacity needs.
profile.tenantDescription: Each company is an isolated merchant workspace with its own users, subscription, and future shipment data.

subscriptions.title: Subscription history
subscriptions.subtitle: Active deal and past plans assigned by the platform team.

assign.title: Assign subscription
assign.subtitle: Replace this company's current plan immediately. The previous subscription moves to history as Replaced.
assign.freeHint: Free plans stay open-ended regardless of billing cycle.
assign.confirmDescription: This replaces {{company}}'s current subscription immediately. The active deal becomes Replaced in history.

team.title: Company team
team.subtitle: People who can access this merchant workspace.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitle: Prepaid balance and ledger for this merchant. Adjustments are visible to the company owner and staff with wallet access.
wallet.summaryHint: Balance is charged for subscriptions and topped up by platform staff.
wallet.adjustDescription: Move balance for {{company}}. The reason you enter is shown to the merchant on their wallet ledger.
wallet.amountHint: Between 0.01 and 1,000,000.00 — up to two decimal places.
wallet.notePlaceholder: Explain why this balance is changing — the merchant will read this.
wallet.noteHint: Required. Shown on the merchant wallet transaction row.
wallet.refundDescription: Add the amount back to {{company}}'s Rawafid wallet. This does not return money to a card and does not change the subscription.
wallet.refundAmountHint: Prefilled with the full refundable amount. Maximum {{remaining}}.
wallet.refundNotePlaceholder: Explain this refund — the merchant will see it on their wallet.
wallet.refundNoteHint: Required. Shown to the merchant on the refund row.

validation.amountDecimals: Use at most two decimal places
validation.amountAboveRefundable: Enter an amount up to the refundable balance
validation.noteMax: Reason must be 500 characters or fewer

plans.metaDescription: Manage subscription plans, pricing tiers, and feature matrices for the Rawafid merchant platform.

hero.title: Plan management
hero.subtitle: Shape the offers merchants see on signup and billing — localized names, volume tiers, and feature limits in one catalog.

toolbar.title: Filter catalog
toolbar.hint: Active plans appear on the public pricing page; archived plans stay assignable by staff only.

empty.title: No plans in the catalog
empty.description: Create the first subscription plan to define what merchants can subscribe to on Rawafid.
empty.filterDescription: Try another status filter or create a new plan.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

detail.metaDescription: Edit pricing tiers, features, and visibility for {{name}} on Rawafid.

create.metaDescription: Add a new subscription plan to the Rawafid catalog with localized copy, tiers, and features.
create.title: Create subscription plan
create.subtitle: Define a plan code, bilingual copy, shipment volume tiers, and the feature matrix merchants will see.

basics.title: Plan identity
basics.description: Codes are permanent identifiers used in subscriptions and admin tools.
basics.codeHint: Uppercase letters, numbers, and underscores only — max 50 characters.
basics.codeImmutable: Plan codes cannot be changed after creation.

tiers.title: Pricing tiers
tiers.description: Each tier pairs a monthly shipment volume with explicit monthly and yearly prices.
tiers.cardDescription: Merchants pick a tier when subscribing. Yearly price is stored separately — not 12× monthly.
tiers.customPricingHint: Custom pricing plans have no tiers — merchants contact the platform team.

features.title: Feature matrix
features.description: Rows appear on the public pricing comparison table.
features.cardDescription: Each feature has a type that controls how it renders for merchants.
features.empty: No features yet — add rows to describe limits and capabilities.
features.unlimitedHint: Unlimited features need no extra value — they render as an unlimited badge.

validation.codeFormat: Use uppercase letters, numbers, and underscores only (max 50)
validation.sortOrder: Enter a valid sort order (0 or higher)
validation.tierPrice: Enter a valid price with up to 2 decimal places
validation.tiersRequired: Add at least one pricing tier, or enable custom pricing
validation.customPricingTiers: Custom pricing plans must not include tiers
validation.duplicateTierVolume: Each tier must have a unique shipment volume
validation.featureNumber: Enter a valid number for this feature
validation.featureEnabled: Choose whether this feature is included
validation.featureText: Enter display text for this feature

form.readOnlyHint: Your role can view plans but not edit them.

lifecycle.defaultHint: The default signup plan cannot be archived.
lifecycle.archiveDescription: {{name}} will disappear from the public pricing page. Existing subscriptions keep their snapshot.
lifecycle.activateDescription: {{name}} will return to the active catalog and can be assigned to companies again.

toast.duplicateCode: A plan with this code already exists
toast.cannotArchiveDefault: The default signup plan cannot be archived

hero.title: Users directory
hero.subtitle: Every person behind a merchant workspace — search by name or email, review verification status, and take moderation action when needed.

toolbar.title: Search and sort users
toolbar.searchHint: Matches first name, last name, full name anywhere, or email.

empty.title: No users yet
empty.description: When merchants register on Rawafid, their owner accounts will appear here for platform oversight.
empty.searchDescription: Try a different name or email address.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

detail.metaDescription: Profile, verification, and moderation for {{name}} on Rawafid.
detail.readOnlyHint: Your role can view user records but cannot change verification or account status.

profile.title: User profile
profile.subtitle: Identity and contact details for this merchant account holder.
profile.workspaceDescription: This user belongs to one merchant company. Suspending them blocks login and revokes every active session immediately.

trust.title: Channel verification
trust.subtitle: Attest email and phone independently — the verified badge requires both channels.
trust.emailVerifiedHint: Mark when the email address has been confirmed by platform staff.
trust.phoneVerifiedHint: Mark when the phone number has been confirmed. Resets if the user changes their number.
trust.overallHint: The overall verified badge updates automatically when both email and phone are attested.

moderation.title: Account moderation
moderation.subtitle: Control whether this user can sign in to their merchant workspace.
moderation.activeDescription: This user can sign in and use the merchant dashboard. Suspending them blocks login and invalidates refresh tokens immediately.
moderation.suspendedDescription: This account is suspended — the user cannot sign in until reactivated.
moderation.suspendDescription: {{name}} will be blocked from signing in and all active sessions will end immediately.
moderation.reactivateDescription: {{name}} will be able to sign in again with their existing credentials.
